# `r if (!is.null(params$cancer_type)) paste(params$cancer_type)`

We perform, for each gene, a linear regression to detect whether patient age is significantly associated with mutation status. Mutation data is binarized (0 = no mutation, 1 = mutation present).

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
set.seed(1)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE,
                      dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 300)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(reactable)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
```

include_race <- params$include_race
include_HPV_status <- params$include_HPV_status
include_subtype <- params$include_subtype
include_grade <- params$include_grade
include_purity <- params$include_purity

}

# Functions

## Linear regression function

```{r}
run_regression_mutation <- function(se, assay, outcome, covariates = NULL, min_group_size = 10) {
  mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(se, assay)
  pheno <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(se)[c(outcome, covariates)])

  if (!is.null(covariates)) {
    categorical_vars <- c("gender", "race", "grade", "subtype_selected")
    categorical_vars <- categorical_vars[categorical_vars %in% covariates]
    pheno[categorical_vars] <- lapply(pheno[categorical_vars], as.factor)
  }

  if (!is.numeric(pheno[[outcome]])) {
    pheno[[outcome]] <- as.numeric(pheno[[outcome]])
  }

  n_with_mutation <- rowSums(mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_without_mutation <- rowSums(mat == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  genes_to_test <- names(n_with_mutation)[
    n_with_mutation >= min_group_size & n_without_mutation >= min_group_size
  ]

  if (length(genes_to_test) == 0) {
    message(paste("No genes passed the min_group_size filter for", assay))
    return(data.frame(
      gene_name = character(),
      beta = numeric(),
      p_val = numeric(),
      adj_p_val = numeric(),
      se = numeric(),
      stat = numeric(),
      n_with_mutation = integer(),
      n_without_mutation = integer()
    ))
  }

  message(paste0("Testing ", length(genes_to_test), " genes (min group size = ", min_group_size, ")"))

  base_formula <- paste0(outcome, " ~ mutation_status")

  if (!is.null(covariates) && length(covariates) > 0) {
    covariates_part <- paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
    model_formula <- as.formula(paste(base_formula, covariates_part, sep = " + "))
  } else {
    model_formula <- as.formula(base_formula)
  }

  cat("Model formula:", deparse(model_formula), "\n")

  results_df <- purrr::map_dfr(genes_to_test, function(gene) {
    mutation_status <- mat[gene, ]
    model_data <- cbind(pheno, mutation_status)
    model_data <- model_data[complete.cases(model_data), ]

    if (nrow(model_data) < min_group_size * 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    tryCatch(
      {
        test_result <- lm(model_formula, data = model_data)
        tidy_test_result <- broom::tidy(test_result) %>%
          dplyr::filter(term == "mutation_status")

        if (nrow(tidy_test_result) == 0) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        data.frame(
          p_val = pull(tidy_test_result["p.value"]),
          beta = pull(tidy_test_result["estimate"]),
          se = pull(tidy_test_result["std.error"]),
          stat = pull(tidy_test_result["statistic"])
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        warning(paste0("Regression failed for gene: ", gene, " - ", e$message))
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
  }, .id = "gene_index")

  if (nrow(results_df) == 0) {
    warning("All regressions failed.")
    return(data.frame(
      gene_name = character(),
      beta = numeric(),
      p_val = numeric(),
      adj_p_val = numeric(),
      se = numeric(),
      stat = numeric(),
      n_with_mutation = integer(),
      n_without_mutation = integer()
    ))
  }

  final_df <- results_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene_name = genes_to_test[as.integer(gene_index)]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_with_mutation = n_with_mutation[gene_name],
      n_without_mutation = n_without_mutation[gene_name]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, beta, p_val, se, stat, n_with_mutation, n_without_mutation)

  final_df <- dplyr::mutate(final_df, adj_p_val = p.adjust(final_df$p_val, method = "BH"), .after = p_val)

  rownames(final_df) <- NULL
  return(final_df)
}
```

## Violin plot function

```{r}
plot_age_by_mutation <- function(gene_name, se_data, assay, results_df) {
  mutation_status <- assay(se_data, assay)[gene_name, ]

  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Age = colData(se_data)$Age,
    Mutation_Status = factor(mutation_status, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("WT", "Mutated"))
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Age))

  counts <- table(plot_data$Mutation_Status)
  count_str <- paste(names(counts), "=", counts, collapse = ", ")

  row <- results_df %>% filter(gene_name == !!gene_name)

  if (nrow(row) == 0) {
    adj_p <- "NA"
    beta_val <- "NA"
  } else {
    adj_p <- format(row$adj_p_val, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
    beta_val <- round(row$beta, 3)
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Mutation_Status, y = Age, fill = Mutation_Status)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue", "Mutated" = "coral")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(gene_name),
      subtitle = paste0(count_str, " | β=", beta_val, ", adj_p=", adj_p),
      x = "Mutation Status",
      y = "Age (years)",
      fill = "Status"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9)
    )
}
```

## Get Binary Mutation Assays

The pancancer_aging SEs use assay names without `_binary` suffix (e.g., `all`, `Missense_Mutation`).

```{r}
available_assays <- assayNames(se)
cat("Available assays:", paste(available_assays, collapse = ", "), "\n")

binary_mutation_types <- available_assays
```

## Linear Regression - WITHOUT Covariates (Age ~ Mutation Status)

```{r}
results_no_cov_list <- list()

for (mut_type in binary_mutation_types) {
  type_results <- run_regression_mutation(
    se = se,
    assay = mut_type,
    outcome = "Age",
    covariates = NULL,
    min_group_size = 10
  )

  if (nrow(type_results) > 0) {
    results_no_cov_list[[mut_type]] <- type_results
  }
}

if (length(results_no_cov_list) > 0) {
  full_results_no_cov <- purrr::list_rbind(results_no_cov_list, names_to = "mut_type")
} else {
  full_results_no_cov <- data.frame(
    mut_type = character(),
    gene_name = character(),
    beta = numeric(),
    p_val = numeric(),
    adj_p_val = numeric(),
    se = numeric(),
    stat = numeric(),
    n_with_mutation = integer(),
    n_without_mutation = integer()
  )
  cat("No genes passed filters for any mutation type.\n")
}

saveRDS(results_no_cov_list, file.path(result_dir, "lm_no_covariates_results_list.rds"))
write.csv(full_results_no_cov, file.path(result_dir, "lm_no_covariates_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved no-covariate results.\n")
```

## Results WITHOUT Covariates {.tabset}

```{r}
for (mut_type in binary_mutation_types) {

  if (!mut_type %in% names(results_no_cov_list) || nrow(results_no_cov_list[[mut_type]]) == 0) {
    cat("\n")
    cat(paste0("### ", mut_type, " - No Results\n"))
    cat("\n")
    cat(paste0("*No genes passed the minimum sample size threshold (n=10 per group) for ", mut_type, ".*\n"))
    cat("\n")
    next
  }

  results_df <- results_no_cov_list[[mut_type]]

  cat("\n")
  cat(paste0("### ", mut_type, "\n"))
  cat("\n")
  cat(paste0("**Total genes tested: ", nrow(results_df), "** | **Significant (FDR ≤ 0.05): ", sum(results_df$adj_p_val <= 0.05), "**\n\n"))

  print(htmltools::tagList(
    results_df %>%
      arrange(adj_p_val) %>%
      reactable_pretty()
  ))

  cat("\n")
}
```

## Linear Regression - WITH Covariates

Covariates for `r selected_cancer_type`: `r paste(covariates, collapse = ", ")`

```{r}
if (length(covariates) > 0) {
  results_with_cov_list <- list()

  for (mut_type in binary_mutation_types) {
    type_results <- run_regression_mutation(
      se = se,
      assay = mut_type,
      outcome = "Age",
      covariates = covariates,
      min_group_size = 10
    )

    if (nrow(type_results) > 0) {
      results_with_cov_list[[mut_type]] <- type_results
    }
  }

  if (length(results_with_cov_list) > 0) {
    full_results_with_cov <- purrr::list_rbind(results_with_cov_list, names_to = "mut_type")
  } else {
    full_results_with_cov <- data.frame(
      mut_type = character(),
      gene_name = character(),
      beta = numeric(),
      p_val = numeric(),
      adj_p_val = numeric(),
      se = numeric(),
      stat = numeric(),
      n_with_mutation = integer(),
      n_without_mutation = integer()
    )
    cat("No genes passed filters for any mutation type (with covariates).\n")
  }

  saveRDS(results_with_cov_list, file.path(result_dir, "lm_with_covariates_results_list.rds"))
  write.csv(full_results_with_cov, file.path(result_dir, "lm_with_covariates_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved with-covariate results.\n")
} else {
  results_with_cov_list <- results_no_cov_list
  full_results_with_cov <- full_results_no_cov
  cat("No covariates specified; using no-covariate results.\n")
}
```

# Comparison: With vs Without Covariates

```{r}
if ("all" %in% names(results_no_cov_list) && "all" %in% names(results_with_cov_list)) {
  comparison_df <- full_results_no_cov %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_type == "all") %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, beta_no_cov = beta, p_val_no_cov = p_val, adj_p_val_no_cov = adj_p_val) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      full_results_with_cov %>%
        dplyr::filter(mut_type == "all") %>%
        dplyr::select(gene_name, beta_with_cov = beta, p_val_with_cov = p_val, adj_p_val_with_cov = adj_p_val),
      by = "gene_name"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      beta_change = beta_with_cov - beta_no_cov,
      sig_no_cov = adj_p_val_no_cov < 0.05,
      sig_with_cov = adj_p_val_with_cov < 0.05,
      status = case_when(
        sig_no_cov & sig_with_cov ~ "Sig Both",
        sig_no_cov & !sig_with_cov ~ "Lost Sig",
        !sig_no_cov & sig_with_cov ~ "Gained Sig",
        TRUE ~ "Not Sig"
      )
    )
} else {
  comparison_df <- data.frame()
  cat("'all' assay not available for comparison.\n")
}
```

# Summary of Significance Changes

```{r}
if (nrow(comparison_df) > 0) {
  comparison_df %>%
    dplyr::count(status) %>%
    reactable_pretty()
} else {
  cat("No comparison data available.\n")
}
```

# Genes That Changed Significance

```{r}
if (nrow(comparison_df) > 0) {
  changed_sig <- comparison_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(status %in% c("Lost Sig", "Gained Sig")) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_name, status, beta_no_cov, adj_p_val_no_cov, beta_with_cov, adj_p_val_with_cov) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(status, adj_p_val_with_cov)

  if (nrow(changed_sig) > 0) {
    reactable_pretty(changed_sig)
  } else {
    cat("No genes changed significance status.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No comparison data available.\n")
}
```

# Visualize Top Significant Genes (WITH Covariates) {.tabset}

Using 'all' assay results.


```{r}
if ("all" %in% names(results_with_cov_list) && nrow(results_with_cov_list[["all"]]) > 0) {
  top_genes <- results_with_cov_list[["all"]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj_p_val < 0.20) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(adj_p_val, n = 10) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene_name)

  if (length(top_genes) > 0) {
    for (gene in top_genes) {
      cat("\n")
      cat(paste0("## ", gene, "\n"))
      cat("\n")
      p <- plot_age_by_mutation(gene, se, "all", results_with_cov_list[["all"]])
      print(p)
      cat("\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No genes with adj_p_val < 0.20 to visualize.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("'all' results not available for visualization.\n")
}
```

# Summary Statistics by Mutation Type

## WITHOUT Covariates

```{r}
if (nrow(full_results_no_cov) > 0) {
  summary_no_cov <- full_results_no_cov %>%
    group_by(mut_type) %>%
    summarise(
      Genes_Tested = n(),
      Sig_FDR_0.05 = sum(adj_p_val < 0.05),
      Sig_FDR_0.20 = sum(adj_p_val < 0.20),
      Median_Beta = median(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_N_Mutated = round(mean(n_with_mutation, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Sig_FDR_0.05))

  reactable_pretty(summary_no_cov)
} else {
  cat("No results available.\n")
}
```
